items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Howard George, everybody could shake a glad hand.

ctx.x: Well, who were some of the Tunk bands, Tunk Brass bands now, you know? Not the reading brass bands, but the ear brass bands. Do they have many regular ones or do they just jump up or what?

Well, I'll tell you how I teach it, it's just late or anything like that. You and his guys are working. You say that there's about two or three brass bands, but before it was different. You take for instance like that poor Steve died. Well, you take a bunch of men and say that there was personally a good friend to him. You see, when you go get sick, you want to make a little one or two hours of Steve there? Sure man. Want to buckle grandma, book a deep grass, myself, and oh, make that up and go up there and get a…
Do you think anybody's gonna ever come back to that old style and play it again ever?
